_howto: Each section renders only if it has items — empty a section's items array to hide it entirely. Per item: title, composer, year, instrumentation, duration, note, score, audio. All optional. 'score' is a path like /music/scores/name.pdf. An 'audio' value starting with / becomes an inline player; a full https:// URL becomes a 'listen' link instead. Replace the EXAMPLE entries with your own.
